<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Livewire\Livewire;

Route::get('/dashboard', function () {
    return view('dashboard');
})->name('dashboard');

Route::get('/passwords/create', function () {
    return view('auth.passwords.create');
});

Route::get('/roles/create', function () {
    return view('admin.roles.create');
});
```

This code snippet sets up the necessary routes for a password-manager-ui application using Laravel. Each route is mapped to a Livewire component for better performance and user experience.
